chunks: So We conveyed to the mother of Moses: "Suckle him. If you are afraid for him, cast him in the river without any fear or regret, for We shall restore him to you, and make him an apostle."
ai.seo_question: What did God reveal to the mother of Moses regarding his upbringing?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the interplay between maternal instinct and divine decree, where the 'casting into the Nile' serves as a mechanism for Moses' elevation to royalty in Pharaoh's house, fulfilling the prophecy of his prophethood. The assurance 'do not fear and do not grieve' underscores the concept of *tawakkul* (trust in God) amidst political turmoil, a theme frequently cited by Imams to illustrate divine protection of the chosen leaders.
